name: Vigorbelt
summary: The set's first Object: a belt for Humans only, and its bearer hits harder.

face.name: Vigorbelt

effect.name: Effect
effect.text: Assign it to one of your Humans: for as long as they wear it, that Human gets +1 Power. When the Human wearing it is retired, draw a card: the Vigorbelt follows them to Requiem and leaves something to those who remain.

face.flavor: Buckle it tight. Vigor does the rest.
